versions.subject: NotPetya Sigma Rule for Sysmon Events
versions.detection:
fsutil_clean_journal:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\fsutil.exe'
    CommandLine: '* deletejournal *'        
pipe_com:
    EventID: 1
    CommandLine: '*\AppData\Local\Temp\* \\.\pipe\*'
event_clean:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\wevtutil.exe'
    CommandLine: '* cl *'
condition: fsutil_clean_journal or pipe_com or event_clean
versions.spl: (EventID=1 Image="*\\fsutil.exe" CommandLine="* deletejournal *") OR (EventID=1 CommandLine="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\* \\.\\pipe\*") OR (EventID=1 Image="*\\wevtutil.exe" CommandLine="* cl *")
